title: Fewest Meeting Rooms
statement:
Each meeting is given as `[start, end]` with `start < end`; a meeting occupies a room for the half-open time range `[start, end)`. A meeting that ends at time `t` frees its room for a meeting that starts at `t`.

Return the minimum number of rooms needed to hold all `meetings`.

examples.explanation: [4,6] and [7,9] can share one room while [2,12] uses another.
The second meeting starts exactly when the first ends.

hints: Sort by start; keep a min-heap of end times of meetings in progress.
